report.headline: Landing pages live for all 8 locations, Google listings fully optimized

done.text: Built and launched 8 dedicated Google Ads landing pages, one per location (Houston, Canton, Fishers, Bridgeview, Orland Park, Lombard, Paterson, Columbus). Each is hidden from Google search so ad visitors stay completely separate from your main SEO pages, excluded from site navigation and sitemap, and verified on desktop and mobile.
Each landing page has location-specific Order Pickup and Call buttons visible above the fold on mobile, with page titles and headings that include Halal, Breakfast, Cafe, Manakeesh and the city name.

Completed full Google listing optimization for Bridgeview, Houston, Lombard, Orland Park and Paterson: new descriptions, missing categories added, menu links set to each store's order page, Google menus built from website prices, services and attributes corrected, Order on Google turned on, and new photos and logos uploaded. Canton and Fishers were done in October.

Scheduled 45 Google listing posts across all active locations, every Tuesday at 9 AM local time through December 29: 7 posts each for Bridgeview, Houston, Lombard, Orland Park and Paterson, and 5 each for Canton and Fishers.

Updated all Bridgeview listings and scheduled posts to remove coffee and espresso following the exclusivity confirmation: new description, Coffee Shop category removed, coffee service replaced with matcha, mojitos and refreshers, and the November 24, December 15 and December 29 posts rewritten. Pizza and deli sandwich menus added to Google listings at Bridgeview, Houston, Lombard, Orland Park and Paterson.
Updated Instagram names and bios across locations.

in_progress.text: Conversion tracking setup is in progress: Google Ads and GA4 tags load on all 8 landing pages, but click conversions on the Order and Call buttons are not yet recording. A test order via the FLOWTEST coupon at Fishers is pending to confirm online-order conversions in Google Ads.

Investigating why Google listing posts for Fishers and Canton show on the backend but not publicly on Search and Maps. Views are being recorded (269 and 591 on two older posts), so the posts are reaching people. A fuller check is underway.

Google Search campaigns for the 6 new locations are in progress. The Houston landing page is confirmed ready, and the Bridgeview campaign is being updated to exclude coffee, espresso and lattes and to reflect the confirmed pizza and deli sandwich items.

waiting_on_you.text: Please send your Thanksgiving hours as soon as possible so we can add them to all your Google listings before the holiday.
The Columbus location's Google listing is not yet in our account, so we cannot schedule posts for it. Could you check with Mohammad and confirm that manager access has been granted for that profile?
Sterling Heights still needs Google verification before we can manage or post on that listing. Please let us know how you would like to proceed.

next_week.text: Complete conversion tracking setup on all 8 landing pages (Order and Call button clicks) and confirm test order conversions are recording in Google Ads.
Add Thanksgiving hours to all listings once received, and follow up on Columbus manager access.
Confirm where Fishers and Canton posts appear on Google Search and Maps and report back.
Switch active campaigns from order links to the new dedicated landing pages, starting with Houston.

internal_flags.text: Location pages item: a post flags that the site-wide header contains a Purchase conversion snippet with placeholder values ({total}, {txid}) that is not firing. This is a tracking bug the client has not been told about. Needs to be resolved as part of the conversion tracking work before campaigns go live.

Google Search: 6 new locations item: the specialist confirmed on Nov 18 that the Houston ordering page 'is also live now' but the item remains In Progress. Confirm whether Houston campaigns have launched and update the item status accordingly.

Weekly GBP posts item: Columbus manager access was requested from Mohammad directly but has not been granted. The email address used for the request is in the original post. Follow up internally to ensure this doesn't delay Columbus scheduling.
Google Ads account + conversion tracking item: the FLOWTEST coupon failed at Fishers on 11/16. Confirm this has been fixed before test orders are placed across all 8 locations.
